architectureDecisions: D1 — Model a product change as REQUIREMENT_CHANGE_V1 bound to project/root, prior accepted requirement/semantic revision refs, replacement content identity, declared acceptance refs and a stable changeKey. A change never mutates historical semantic artifacts; it publishes a replacement revision and relies on current lineage to derive affected work.

D2 — Use the delivered ProductLineageStore/current semantic heads and reverseSemanticClosure as the only dependency invalidation source. Only derivation edges to currently selected dependent revisions participate; Blackboard dependency edges and role labels are not semantic invalidation graphs.

D3 — Freeze two scenario classes over the BB-070 delivered reference product: LOCAL_DOMAIN changes one presentation-only requirement whose current lineage is confined to FE; CROSS_DOMAIN changes one validation/API contract whose lineage reaches BE, FE and QA. Scenario manifests name exact starting semantic refs before execution.

D4 — Invalidated current outputs become stale/reopened through the delivered dependency-invalidation/currentness boundary; unrelated current semantic heads remain untouched. Re-execution creates replacement revisions and downstream obligations from the changed revision rather than re-running the whole organization.

D5 — Recovery consumes the exact delivered BB-057 recovery/fencing boundary. Process kill/resume must reuse the same semantic execution attempt/binding; duplicate activation must converge on the existing publication idempotency key; an old claim/worker or stale deployment observation cannot publish or close changed work.

D6 — Browser/deployment verification uses Playwright v1.63.0 only for observable post-change evidence bound to the new release. The authoritative change/currentness decision remains ExHarness semantic lineage + independent QA/closure.

D7 — Temporal v1.32.0 and Restate v1.7.11 are rejected for this task's recovery authority. Their durable workflow/step models are useful references but would introduce a second durable execution authority and do not replace ExHarness external-effect ambiguity/currentness fences.

D8 — Worker preflight requires BB-070 and BB-057 DONE and binds their exact product-lifecycle and recovery outputs. Any mismatch in change-entry, attempt recovery or publication-fencing seams is PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.

expectedDependencyOutputs: BB-070 DONE: exact PROJECT_SEED/product-lifecycle/reference-product seam and current product outcome/release identity used as the change baseline.
BB-057 DONE: exact adversarial recovery, stale-worker and bounded-remediation APIs/evidence; Worker must bind the delivered names/refs.

implementationSlices: S0 — Dependency preflight: require BB-070 and BB-057 DONE and bind exact lifecycle/reference-product plus recovery/fencing outputs; reject incompatible delivered seams.
S1 — Change contract: implement REQUIREMENT_CHANGE_V1 and deterministic scenario manifests that pin the exact pre-change semantic heads and acceptance refs.

S2 — Selective invalidation composition: publish replacement requirement/semantic revision, derive affected current closure only through ProductLineageStore/reverseSemanticClosure, invoke delivered invalidation semantics for affected work and prove unrelated heads remain current.

S3 — Selective live repair: implement and run LOCAL_DOMAIN plus CROSS_DOMAIN from BB071_CHANGE_RECOVERY_V1 over independently reset copies of the exact accepted BB-070 release. Derive affected work only from current reverse semantic lineage, prove protected control heads stay current, and independently verify each replacement release.

S4 — Recovery/fencing live probes: execute KILL_RESUME_DUPLICATE and STALE_FENCE at the frozen durable barriers in BB071_CHANGE_RECOVERY_V1; require same semantic attempt/binding, one logical authoritative publication, stale worker/deployment rejection and unchanged unrelated heads.

S5 — Persist and independently audit the complete BB071_CHANGE_RECOVERY_V1 evidence matrix (pre/post semantic heads, affected/unaffected sets, claim/attempt/binding/publication/release identities, Playwright/API/persistence/QA evidence and raw failures). NOT_RUN or missing evidence cannot satisfy the objective.

S6 — Update Living truth with selective-change/recovery capability and explicit limits; do not claim generic workflow durability or exactly-once external effects beyond the delivered reconciliation contract.
